stock.description: Zhong Ao Home Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, delivering a broad spectrum of property-related services throughout the People's Republic of China. Its offerings encompass not only standard property management but also a variety of support services, including cleaning, landscaping, security, repairs, general maintenance, and personalized butler assistance. These services are provided to a diverse clientele, covering residential and non-residential buildings, commercial complexes, and government facilities, alongside specialized indoor and outdoor environmental cleaning, greening, and upkeep. The company also provides real estate brokerage services, aiding property developers and owners with the rental and sale of residential properties and retail units. Furthermore, Zhong Ao Home Group assists property developers with sales, offers landscaping design and construction, provides engineering services, and caters events. It also trades in engineering spare parts. The company was founded in 2005, with its main office located in Guangzhou, PRC, and operates as a subsidiary of Qichang International Limited.
